findings.evidence: Legacy pipeline/agents/vcs/utils and new engines/* coexist
findings.problem: Dual orchestrator trees (legacy vs engines) causing drift and regression maintenance burden
findings.recommended_fix: Deprecate legacy tree in favor of engines; add import-linter to enforce boundary

findings.evidence: God-modules detected
findings.problem: God-modules: cli/handlers.py, full_pipeline.py, sentinel/*, OrchestratorConfig are monolithic
findings.recommended_fix: Extract sub-handlers; split config into role-specific models

findings.evidence: core/protocols.py imports openhands.sdk.Agent directly
findings.problem: Concrete SDK leak through protocol layer; breaks abstraction
findings.recommended_fix: Remove openhands.sdk.Agent import from protocols; use typing.Protocol shape

findings.evidence: Mutual imports with lazy guards
findings.problem: Circular import risk between orchestrator.py and pipeline.dispatcher
findings.recommended_fix: Extract shared types to a neutral module; use lazy imports only

findings.evidence: 4 overlapping sources of truth
findings.problem: Config schema drift: schema.py, config_schema.json, orchestrator.config.json, core/config.py
findings.recommended_fix: Consolidate schema truth into orchestrator/config/schema.py; regenerate JSON from it

findings.evidence: Compiled UI bundles committed
findings.problem: Compiled UI bundles committed; should be build artifacts not source-controlled
findings.recommended_fix: Remove dist/ from HEAD; add build step in CI

findings.evidence: Stale phase plans and full worktree duplicates committed
findings.problem: Documentation & worktree bloat: stale phase plans and full .kilo/worktrees duplicate committed to repo
findings.recommended_fix: Prune stale plans; add .kilo/worktrees/ to .gitignore

findings.evidence: sk- regex not anchored
findings.problem: Secret redaction regex not anchored; over-redacts and false-positives on non-key text
findings.recommended_fix: Anchor with known provider prefixes and word boundaries

findings.evidence: DISALLOWED_OPERATORS is a Set[str] with raw substring matching
findings.problem: Operator deny-list substring matching; can allow/deny incorrectly
findings.recommended_fix: Use proper shell tokenizer (shlex for POSIX, PowerShell AST for Windows)

findings.evidence: APPROVED_ROOT_COMMANDS includes cat/ls/type/dir/get-content without boundary check
findings.problem: No workspace boundary on file read commands; is_sensitive_filepath not enforced on every command
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve every argument against workspace root; reject any path escaping workspace_path

findings.evidence: sanitize_text_secrets iterates os.environ and replaces values
findings.problem: Env enumeration leakage in redaction; embeds key names, O(N*M)
findings.recommended_fix: Build single alternation regex once per process from secret values; cache it

findings.evidence: JWT regex trailing .?[...]* permits zero-length segments
findings.problem: JWT regex trailing optional segments causes odd partial redaction
findings.recommended_fix: Require both dots: eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}

findings.evidence: No test matrix enumerating APPROVED_ROOT_COMMANDS x DISALLOWED_OPERATORS
findings.problem: No allow-list bypass fuzz tests
findings.recommended_fix: Add fuzz test matrix covering all command/operator combinations

findings.evidence: .env present at repo root; cat .env via agent can exfiltrate provider keys
findings.problem: .env committed and exfiltration risk
findings.recommended_fix: Move .env out of version control; add to .gitignore; load via OS keychain

findings.evidence: Default fallback chain uses free models; MAX_BUDGET_USD=0.50 may trip
findings.problem: Free-tier fallback fragility; budget may exceed before governor trips
findings.recommended_fix: Add pre-check on budget ceiling before free-model fallback chain

findings.evidence: self_healing_level defaults to full_autonomous
findings.problem: Autonomous self-heal default; recommend human_in_the_loop for first release
findings.recommended_fix: Default self_healing_level to human_in_the_loop

findings.evidence: API key fields stored as Optional[str]
findings.problem: API keys not SecretStr; serializable to JSON; repr/log leakage
findings.recommended_fix: Use pydantic.SecretStr for all key fields

findings.evidence: max_iterations: Union[int, str] with raw string fallback
findings.problem: max_iterations Union typing defect; numeric comparison raises TypeError
findings.recommended_fix: Replace Union[int,str] with int + unlimited_iterations boolean flag

findings.evidence: workspace_path resolved at class-definition time
findings.problem: workspace_path frozen at import; late env set not reflected
findings.recommended_fix: Use model_validator to re-resolve on each instance construction

findings.evidence: DomainProfile.environment_variables injected into agent subprocesses
findings.problem: Unvalidated environment_variables injection without validation
findings.recommended_fix: Allow-list keys; reject PATH, LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_*, PYTHON*, BASH_ENV, ENV

findings.evidence: Options added to one schema source but not others
findings.problem: Config option divergence; silently fail when added to one source only
findings.recommended_fix: Consolidate schema truth; add CI check that all sources are in sync

findings.evidence: load_dotenv() at module import time
findings.problem: Module-import side effect load_dotenv; masks bugs where tests expect isolated env
findings.recommended_fix: Move load_dotenv() into CLI entrypoint and ConfigLoader.load()

findings.evidence: run_tasks interleaves saves; crash mid-task leaves queue IN_PROGRESS
findings.problem: Task queue IN_PROGRESS state not recovered after crash
findings.recommended_fix: On run_tasks start, scan queue and reset IN_PROGRESS items older than threshold to PENDING

findings.evidence: hasattr(run, '_mock_self') is fragile test leak
findings.problem: Mock-detection in production code; fragile test leak
findings.recommended_fix: Use dependency injection with a real AgentRunner protocol

findings.evidence: stop_on_failure=False with many failures grows queue
findings.problem: Unbounded task queue growth
findings.recommended_fix: Add max_queue_size and soft cap on total task count

findings.evidence: Single returns dict, batch returns Dict[str,Any]
findings.problem: Inconsistent return typing run_task vs run_tasks
findings.recommended_fix: Unify on a TaskResult TypedDict/dataclass

findings.evidence: raw_ws.is_file() falls back to parent dir with warning
findings.problem: Silent workspace file-to-parent fallback; masks user path errors
findings.recommended_fix: Default to hard error; only fall back with explicit --parent-fallback flag

findings.evidence: COLUMNS=160, log levels set before user override
findings.problem: Hardcoded env overrides in CLI; user config ignored
findings.recommended_fix: Load config first; only set defaults when user hasn't specified

findings.evidence: --sentinel-heal with const='.' combined with S-03
findings.problem: sentinel-heal accepts unbounded path; can traverse full filesystem and mutate AST
findings.recommended_fix: Force explicit workspace-relative target; refuse to operate outside workspace_path; require --yes

findings.evidence: 20+ top-level flags, no subcommands
findings.problem: Flat CLI with no subcommands; poor discoverability
findings.recommended_fix: Introduce argparse subcommands (oragai run, heal, logs, status, config)

findings.evidence: diagnostics/memory & reports contain runtime payloads
findings.problem: Diagnostics telemetry committed to repo; partial redaction may leak secrets
findings.recommended_fix: Add diagnostics/ to .gitignore; add CI check for key patterns

findings.evidence: .kilo/worktrees/bead-handle full duplicate incl .git committed
findings.problem: git worktree duplicate committed; bloats clones
findings.recommended_fix: Remove from HEAD; add .kilo/worktrees/ to .gitignore

findings.evidence: Hashed JS bundles committed
findings.problem: Stale UI dist in HEAD; stale UI can be served
findings.recommended_fix: Remove dist/ from HEAD; add build step in CI

findings.evidence: Security fuzzing & permission escalation tests not required before merge
findings.problem: No CI gate on security hardening tests
findings.recommended_fix: Add required CI step blocking PRs on security-fuzzing regression
